episodes.title: 'Unexpected item in bagging area' 🛒 #shorts
episodes.logline: Margo battles a self-checkout that keeps detecting an unexpected item, which turns out to be Sloane asleep in the bagging area.
episodes.description: The self-checkout was right for once. Flat 4B.

shots.keyframe: Margo at a self-checkout scanning a single apple, the machine screen flashing red
shots.action: the machine flashes, Margo's eye twitches

lines.t: Unexpected item in bagging area. Again.

shots.keyframe: Margo removing items from the bag one by one, glaring at the screen
shots.action: she lifts the apple, puts it back; the machine beeps red each time
shots.camera: close up on her paws and the flashing light

lines.t: I have one apple. ONE. I have a degree in maths.

shots.keyframe: Dougie arriving with a basket, peering at the bagging area
shots.action: Dougie leans over and lifts the edge of a large shopping bag

lines.t: Margo... I think the machine's right.

shots.keyframe: Sloane curled up asleep inside the bagging area, beanie over his eyes, cosy
shots.action: Sloane slowly lifts his beanie and opens one eye

lines.t: How long have you been there?

shots.keyframe: Sloane sitting up in the bagging area, the machine screen flashing green
shots.action: the machine happily prints a very long receipt

episodes.loop_note: loops to the first red error beep

episodes.title: Planning a surprise for the friend who hates surprises 🎂 #shorts
episodes.logline: The flatmates plan Margo's surprise party on a spreadsheet they accidentally shared with her, only for Margo to have planned a surprise party for all of them the same night.
episodes.hook_text: She hates surprises. We did it anyway.

shots.keyframe: Dougie and Pidge whispering over a laptop, a party hat on Dougie
shots.action: they huddle, Dougie hides balloons behind his back

lines.t: Operation Birthday Cat. She can never find out.

shots.keyframe: Margo in the kitchen, her laptop pinging with a notification
shots.action: she opens the laptop, reads, raises one eyebrow

shots.keyframe: dark hallway, Dougie and Pidge crouched with a cake and confetti cannons
shots.action: the front door opens, they leap up

shots.keyframe: Margo standing in the doorway calmly holding her own cake, wearing a party hat
shots.action: she pulls a string and her own confetti cannon goes off

lines.t: Surprise. Your party. Today. I have a spreadsheet.

shots.keyframe: living room covered in confetti, two cakes, Sloane slowly blowing a party horn
shots.action: the party horn uncurls very slowly

episodes.title: The smart speaker hates fast talkers 🔊 #shorts
episodes.logline: Pidge's new smart speaker can't understand his rapid hustle-talk but obeys Sloane's ultra-slow voice perfectly.
episodes.hook_text: His smart speaker only obeys ONE flatmate

orb.name: Orb
orb.ref_prompt: a small round glowing smart speaker on the coffee table with a ring of soft blue light that pulses when it talks, two simple cartoon eyes in the light

shots.keyframe: Pidge unboxing a glowing smart speaker on the coffee table
shots.action: Pidge speaks rapidly at the speaker, its light pulses confused

shots.keyframe: Pidge leaning in close to the speaker, nose to light
shots.action: he repeats himself even faster

shots.keyframe: Sloane drifting into frame, leaning slowly toward the speaker
shots.action: the speaker light glows bright happy green as Sloane speaks

shots.keyframe: Pidge sitting cross-legged, breathing deeply, eyes closed like meditating
shots.action: Pidge opens his eyes and speaks with painful slowness

shots.keyframe: the hallway filling with pizza boxes stacked to the ceiling, delivery drivers queuing out the door
shots.action: boxes keep sliding in through the door, Margo pinned against the wall

lines.t: I paused too long between 'one' and 'large'.

episodes.title: I accidentally hit 'reply all' 😰 #shorts
episodes.logline: Dougie accidentally sends a Monday-meetings rant to the whole company and attempts a heist to stop it, only for everyone, including his boss, to reply 'me too'.

heron.name: Mr Heron
heron.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic tall grey heron man, thin long beak, tiny rectangular glasses, slim grey suit and skinny tie, holding a coffee cup, stands upright

shots.keyframe: Dougie at his desk smirking and typing an email
shots.action: he clicks send with a flourish

lines.t: Does anyone else hate Monday meetings? Sent to Pidge.

shots.keyframe: close on Dougie's face as the monitor light turns red on him
shots.action: his ears shoot straight up, his pupils shrink

shots.keyframe: Dougie in a black turtleneck rolling across the office floor like a spy
shots.action: he dodges between desks, leaps over a photocopier, dives toward a server cabinet

lines.t: If I unplug the internet... nobody reads it.

shots.keyframe: Dougie frozen mid-dive, Mr Heron standing over him with a coffee
shots.action: Heron looks down at Dougie on the floor

lines.t: I can explain. I cannot explain.

shots.keyframe: the whole office behind them, every monitor lighting up with a ping
shots.action: ping after ping across all the screens, coworkers nodding

episodes.title: We all secretly watered the plant 🪴 #shorts
episodes.logline: Each flatmate secretly waters Margo's dying plant at night until it floods, and Margo reveals it's plastic just as it sprouts a real flower.
episodes.description: Love finds a way. So does water. Flat 4B.

shots.keyframe: Margo looking at a droopy potted plant on the windowsill
shots.action: a single leaf flops down

lines.t: Nobody touch the plant. I have a system.

shots.keyframe: night, Dougie sneaking to the plant with a watering can
shots.action: Dougie waters it and sneaks away; Pidge immediately sneaks in and pours a whole bottle

shots.keyframe: Sloane very slowly carrying a full bucket to the plant
shots.action: he tips the whole bucket; water overflows across the windowsill and onto the floor

shots.keyframe: morning, the living room flooded ankle-deep, the plant floating in its pot, Margo in wellies
shots.action: everyone sheepishly avoids eye contact

lines.t: It's plastic. I bought it to see who cared.

shots.keyframe: close on the plastic plant
shots.action: a real tiny pink flower slowly blooms from the plastic plant; Margo stares

episodes.title: When the Wi-Fi goes down 📶 #shorts
episodes.logline: When the Wi-Fi dies the flatmates are forced to play a board game and bond, until it reconnects and they instantly go silent on their phones.
episodes.description: Forty minutes of human connection. Flat 4B.

shots.keyframe: all four flatmates on the sofa staring at phones, then the router light blinks red
shots.action: everyone gasps and looks up from their phones

shots.keyframe: Margo pulling a dusty board game box from under the sofa
shots.action: she blows dust off the box dramatically

lines.t: Stay calm. We have... the ancient ways.

shots.keyframe: the flatmates around the coffee table playing the game, laughing
shots.action: montage of laughing, high-fives, Dougie hugging Pidge

shots.keyframe: close on the router, its light turns green
shots.action: everyone's heads snap toward the router

shots.keyframe: everyone back on the sofa staring at phones in silence, except Sloane still holding a game piece
shots.action: Sloane slowly places the game piece on the board, alone

episodes.title: The last biscuit standoff 🍪 #shorts
episodes.logline: Margo, Dougie and Pidge face off in a western-style standoff over the last biscuit until the landlady snatches it citing house rules.
episodes.description: There can only be one. Flat 4B.

shots.keyframe: a single biscuit on a plate in the centre of the kitchen table, lit like treasure
shots.action: camera circles the biscuit as a dust bunny rolls past like tumbleweed

shots.keyframe: extreme close ups of Margo's narrowed eyes, then Dougie's twitching paw
shots.action: quick cuts between eyes and twitching paws

shots.keyframe: Pidge chewing a toothpick, cap pulled low like a cowboy
shots.action: Pidge flexes his wing toward the plate

shots.keyframe: all three lunging toward the biscuit in slow motion
shots.action: just before they grab it, a paw in a floral sleeve snatches it through the window

shots.keyframe: Mrs Badger on the stairs eating the biscuit, holding her clipboard
shots.action: she takes a satisfied bite and walks upstairs

lines.t: Rule number forty-seven. Last biscuit goes to the landlady.

episodes.title: Monday motivation vs. actual Monday ☔ #shorts
episodes.logline: Dougie's motivational Monday post is followed by a disastrous commute, while Sloane's video of doing nothing goes viral.
episodes.description: Rise and grind. Or don't. Flat 4B.

shots.keyframe: Dougie by a sunny window holding his phone, posing with a mug
shots.action: he takes a selfie with a huge grin

lines.t: Rise and grind! Mondays are a gift!

shots.keyframe: Dougie walking down the street with an umbrella, smiling
shots.action: the umbrella flips inside out, a bus drives past and splashes him with a wave of puddle water
shots.camera: wide, slow motion on the splash

lines.t: A gift. A gift. A wet gift.

shots.keyframe: Pidge filming Sloane lying motionless on the sofa
shots.action: Sloane blinks once very slowly; Pidge posts the clip

lines.t: Sloane doing absolutely nothing. Posting it.

shots.keyframe: Pidge's phone exploding with glowing notification hearts flying everywhere
shots.action: hearts swirl around the room, Pidge stares at the screen

lines.t: Mate. A million views. They're calling you 'Monday Mood'.

shots.keyframe: soaked Dougie entering the hallway as Sloane lies on the floor in a sunbeam
shots.action: Dougie drips, Sloane gives a slow thumbs up

episodes.title: Fancy restaurant portions be like 🍽️ #shorts
episodes.logline: At a fancy restaurant Pidge eats the tiny decorative leaf on his plate and learns it was ninety pounds of edible gold.
episodes.description: Fine dining for a pigeon. Flat 4B.

gerald.name: Gerald
gerald.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic emperor penguin waiter, natural tuxedo plumage, white napkin over one flipper, small silver tray, very upright posture

shots.keyframe: Gerald placing a giant white plate with one tiny dot of food and a small shiny gold leaf in front of Pidge
shots.action: Pidge leans in, squinting at the tiny portion

shots.keyframe: Pidge pecking the tiny dot of food in one go
shots.action: he swallows, looks around, then pecks the shiny leaf too

lines.t: Still starving. Bit of garnish then.

shots.keyframe: Gerald frozen, holding the bill, Pidge with a gold fleck on his beak
shots.action: Gerald slowly sets down the bill

lines.t: Sir. That was the gold leaf. Ninety pounds.

shots.keyframe: Pidge sweating, turning to Margo across the table
shots.action: Margo calmly sips water without looking up

shots.keyframe: Pidge offering Gerald a handful of breadsticks from his vest pocket
shots.action: Gerald considers, then takes one breadstick and bites it

episodes.title: Working from home with flatmates 💻 #shorts
episodes.logline: Margo stays perfectly composed on a work video call while total chaos erupts behind her, protected by a virtual background, until it glitches.
episodes.hook_text: Her video call vs. her flat 💻
episodes.description: Professional from the shoulders up. Flat 4B.

heron.name: Mr Heron
heron.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic tall grey heron man, thin long beak, tiny rectangular glasses, slim grey suit and skinny tie, holding a coffee cup, stands upright

shots.keyframe: Margo in a blazer at the coffee table facing a laptop, perfectly composed
shots.action: she straightens her glasses and smiles professionally

shots.keyframe: behind Margo, Dougie chasing a tennis ball and Pidge running a market stall selling socks
shots.action: chaos behind Margo: Dougie crashes into the stall, socks fly everywhere

shots.keyframe: split view: Mr Heron on the laptop screen, Margo calm in front of a serene virtual office background
shots.action: a sock lands on Margo's head; she doesn't react

lines.t: Margo, your office looks so peaceful.

shots.keyframe: Sloane slowly crawling across the back of the room carrying a full bowl of cereal
shots.action: Sloane crawls behind Margo; the virtual background glitches and flickers

shots.keyframe: the virtual background gone, revealing total chaos, Margo still composed with a sock on her head
shots.action: Margo slowly reaches for the laptop lid

lines.t: Margo... is that a sock market?

episodes.title: Parallel parking a scooter be like 🛵 #shorts
episodes.logline: Pidge fails to park his scooter in an enormous empty space despite Dougie's directions and finally parks it in the flat's bathtub.
episodes.description: Parking is a state of mind. Flat 4B.

shots.keyframe: Pidge on his scooter beside a huge empty parking space big enough for a bus
shots.action: Pidge revs confidently

shots.keyframe: Dougie on the pavement waving directions like an airport marshal
shots.action: Pidge reverses the wrong way and bumps the kerb each time

lines.t: Left! Your other left! The left that's right!

shots.keyframe: the scooter wedged sideways across the giant space, Pidge upside down in a hedge
shots.action: Pidge pops out of the hedge with leaves in his feathers
shots.camera: top-down showing the huge empty space

lines.t: Space is too big. That's the problem. Too big.

shots.keyframe: Margo opening the bathroom door to find the scooter parked neatly in the bathtub
shots.action: Margo stares, the scooter's headlight blinks at her

lines.t: Why is there a scooter in the bath?

shots.keyframe: Pidge leaning casually in the bathroom doorway with a towel over his shoulder
shots.action: Pidge points at the perfectly aligned scooter proudly

lines.t: Rule forty-seven is going to hear about this.

episodes.loop_note: loops to the huge empty space

episodes.title: The landlady's surprise fire drill 🔥 #shorts
episodes.logline: Margo's toast sets off the fire alarm and everyone evacuates in pyjamas, only to find the landlady timing them for a surprise fire drill.

shots.keyframe: Margo at the toaster at night in pyjamas, a thin wisp of smoke rising
shots.action: the smoke alarm on the ceiling begins to flash

shots.keyframe: hallway chaos: Dougie carrying a houseplant and a pillow, Pidge carrying his scooter helmet and a cash box
shots.action: they collide in the doorway and squeeze out together

shots.keyframe: the flatmates on the rainy street at night in pyjamas, counting heads
shots.action: Margo counts on her claws, Dougie looks around worried

lines.t: He's too slow! He's still inside!

shots.keyframe: Sloane already sitting on a garden wall behind them in a raincoat with a flask of tea
shots.action: Sloane sips slowly

lines.t: I left... when she bought the toaster.

shots.keyframe: Mrs Badger stepping out of the shadows in a hard hat with a clipboard and stopwatch
shots.action: she clicks the stopwatch and writes on the clipboard

episodes.title: When you see your ex and try to act cool 😎 #shorts
episodes.logline: Dougie tries to act cool when his ex walks into the cafe and walks straight into a glass door, but she finds it charming.
episodes.hook_text: Acting cool in front of your ex 😎

bella.name: Bella
bella.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic elegant white standard poodle woman in her late twenties, fluffy styled fur, kind eyes, camel coat and red scarf, holding a coffee cup, stands upright

shots.keyframe: Dougie and Pidge at a cafe table, Dougie spotting someone at the door and stiffening
shots.action: Dougie's tail goes rigid, his ears perk up

lines.t: It's Bella. My ex. Act cool.

shots.keyframe: Dougie leaning on the counter trying to look casual, wearing sunglasses indoors
shots.action: his elbow slips and he knocks a tower of cups over

lines.t: Oh hey. Didn't see you there. I'm very relaxed.

shots.keyframe: Dougie strutting toward the exit in sunglasses
shots.action: he walks face-first into the closed glass door and slides down it

lines.t: Anyway, I'm off to my very busy life.

shots.keyframe: Bella crouching beside Dougie on the floor, holding his fallen lanyard
shots.action: she hands him the lanyard with a laugh

lines.t: Dougie. You dropped your lanyard. And your dignity.

shots.keyframe: Bella sitting down at their table, Pidge pretending to read a menu
shots.action: Dougie's tail starts wagging furiously behind him

episodes.title: Secret Santa in our flat 🎁 #shorts
episodes.logline: In the flat's Secret Santa every gift turns out to be a regift that circles back to its original buyer, and Sloane's gift is still being wrapped.
episodes.hook_text: Our Secret Santa went full circle 🎁
episodes.description: It's the thought that counts. The same thought. Flat 4B.

shots.keyframe: the flatmates in Christmas jumpers around a small tree, Margo opening a gift
shots.action: she pulls out a label maker refill and smiles

lines.t: Label maker refills. I love it.

shots.keyframe: Margo noticing her own handwriting on the gift tag
shots.action: she slowly turns the tag toward Pidge
shots.camera: close up on tag, rack focus to Pidge

lines.t: This is the gift I gave you last year.

shots.keyframe: Dougie opening his gift, revealing the novelty mug he bought someone else
shots.action: Dougie and Pidge look at each other, then at all the gifts

lines.t: Wait. This is MY mug. I gave this away!
Everything's a regift. It's the circle of life.

shots.keyframe: Sloane in the corner slowly wrapping a present, tape stuck to his claws
shots.action: Sloane tears a single piece of tape, very slowly

lines.t: Sloane, where's your Secret Santa gift?

shots.keyframe: Sloane holding up the wrapped gift with a tag
shots.action: the tag flips around in close up

episodes.loop_note: loops to the first gift opening

episodes.title: Who keeps rearranging the fridge at 3AM? 🕵️ #shorts
episodes.logline: Margo calls a formal flat meeting to expose who rearranges the fridge every night, and the hidden camera footage reveals she does it in her sleep.
episodes.description: The call is coming from inside the cardigan. Flat 4B.

shots.keyframe: Margo in front of a projected presentation with charts, the flatmates sitting in a row like students
shots.action: Margo clicks to the next slide with a laser pointer

lines.t: Agenda item one. Someone reorganises the fridge every night at 3AM.

shots.keyframe: Dougie raising his paw nervously
shots.action: Margo points the laser at Dougie's chest, he sweats

lines.t: I only open the fridge to say hello to the cheese.

shots.keyframe: Margo holding up a tiny hidden camera triumphantly
shots.action: she presses play on the remote, the room darkens

lines.t: Luckily, I installed a camera. Let's meet our criminal.

shots.keyframe: grainy night-vision footage of Margo sleepwalking in her pyjamas with a label maker, eyes closed
shots.action: sleeping Margo labels and rearranges the fridge, humming

shots.keyframe: everyone slowly turning to look at Margo, who stands frozen with the remote
shots.action: Sloane slowly raises his hand

episodes.loop_note: gavel loops to the presentation click
